steps.title: Notebook
steps.detail: A researcher tags cells in a Jupyter notebook with @harbor.step markers.

steps.title: Pipeline spec
steps.detail: Harbor lifts the tagged cells into an Argo Workflow spec and commits it.

steps.title: Training job
steps.detail: The workflow runs on a GPU pool with cached datasets mounted from S3.

steps.title: Model registry
steps.detail: Trained weights, metrics, and a signature are pushed to MLflow.

steps.title: Serving
steps.detail: A FastAPI wrapper is deployed automatically with rolling health checks.
